↳ Posted by JACKB on February 23rd, 2014.

“Patrick O’Keeffe’s” / “Mary Duggan’s”, X:8

This setting from the playing of John Sullivan of Glentanefinnane, Ballydesmond, Co. Cork. I think it was learned from Patrick O’Keeffe, but am unsure if it is related to the composition mentioned above. Name given by the musician is “Mary Duggan’s”.

John plays it here:
https://soundcloud.com/thady-quill/glountanefinnane-primrose-vale-jigs?in=thady-quill/sets/john-osullivan-music-from

↳ Posted by Thady Quill on December 28th, 2016.

The Hag With The Money, X:10

This (X:10) is a version of the variant X:9 of the jig posted above.
This variant, another regular jig (32 bars), is as close as it gets to the original song without showing the extra beats that characterise it.
( Many other sung jigs are characterised by extra beats or bars -or missing ones.)

Pipers will relish the ghost D ( shown as Eb here) which is an inflexion found in sean-nós singing.
Tip:
Play any ddd / ded / d_ed (_e = Eb) group of quavers interchangeably…
